attributes.name: hotel_id
attributes.description: A unique identifier for each hotel or guesthouse.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the hotel or guesthouse.

attributes.name: address
attributes.description: The physical address of the hotel or guesthouse.

attributes.name: postcode
attributes.description: The postal code of the hotel or guesthouse.

attributes.name: stars
attributes.description: The star rating of the hotel or guesthouse.

attributes.name: price_range
attributes.description: The price range of the hotel or guesthouse, such as 'cheap', 'moderate', or 'expensive'.

attributes.name: area
attributes.description: The area of the town where the hotel or guesthouse is located, such as 'north', 'south', 'east', or 'west'.

attributes.name: free_wifi
attributes.description: A boolean indicating whether the hotel or guesthouse offers free WiFi.

attributes.name: free_parking
attributes.description: A boolean indicating whether the hotel or guesthouse offers free parking.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of accommodation, such as 'hotel' or 'guesthouse'.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: The contact phone number of the hotel or guesthouse.
